content: Kristen sapakwa nyanugw vagaluwdiy Jiruwsalimaam maaj lakatiyik nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duw taakw daya yawiyik.

Nuwukadiy Juwtiya tamiya kidiy duw Antiyakaar yakuw, day maaj kwiydadiy Jisas dikidiy gwalugwa duwak. Day wadiy, “Gwur gwuradiy sipaam kaam sakw maarkigwura Mawsis diki lo wadil pik, God gwuraam kwar maa.”

Aw Polawa Banapas dayawa day awarwa awarwa maaj warjuwun majir wariyadiy. Atawa wariyakuw, a tipa kidiy Kristen yaakiya wadiy Polawa Banapas nuwukadiy Antiyak Kristen duwawa Jiruwsalimaar yidakikik God dikidiy wayakididiy duwawa Kristen sapakwa nyanugwawa ki maaj lakatiydakik.

Antiyak Kristen wayakikuw, day ata yidiy. Antiyak wapakuw, Paniysiya-wa Samariya abir tamiyaar yikuw, day abir tamiyaam kwadiy Kristenak wadadiy ata ata nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw Godak wukijibir tidiy. Adiy Kristen a jaav wukikuw, rakarak tidiy.

Jiruwsalimaam wulakuw, Kristen-awa God dikidiy wayakididiy duwawa, a tipa kidiy Kristen sapakwa nyanugwawa, dayak rakarak tidiy yadakikik. Day ata Jiruwsalim Kristenak wadiy adiy jaav God kwurdidiy dayawa.
Aw nuwukadiy duw, day Parasiy bapa duw day Kristen tidiy, rapikuw, wadiy, “Nyan kidiy nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy Kristenak wakwanadiyan day daya sipaam kaam sukwukwadiy, Mawsis diki lo-ab wukikuw.”
Pita diki maaja.
God dikidiy wayakididiy duwawa, Kristen sapakwa nyanugwawa vagaluwdiy ki maaj lakatiyik.

Aw day maaj samasam bwulakuw, Pita rapikuw, wadidiy, “Wunadiy gwalugwa duw, gwur abab lakwu-nadiygwur tayir God gwurak tasakwu-didiwun diki viyakita maaj wasapwiy-tuwkik nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw takwak, aw day wukikuw, dikik wukijibir tidakikik.
“God ababa duw taakw dayadiy mawul lakwu-kwanaad. Di bwu yaakiya wakuw dayak, dikidi Mawul bwutaay kwiydid nyanak kwiydidi pik.
“Di nyanak kapab, dayak kapab maa kwar. Dayak ab day dayadiy valik wukikuw, yibwiydidiy.
“Agwa javik gwur Godak vasibariyik kwur-nadiygwurik nimadiy yawiy dayak kwiykuw? Nyanadiy warag nyanabab kidiy yawiy kwurkwur maa rav.
“Aw nyan kita wukijibir tibaak, God nyanak sukwasukw kwurkuw, di nyigil-dadiyan. Atawa nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duw taakw ab nyigil-dadiy.”
Adiy vagaluwdiy duw day maaj maa bwul. Aw day lakwudaal Banapasawa Pol bir wabiridiy niki yawiy niki yawiy God kwurdidiy birak, nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw daya nyidim tibir.
Jamis diki maaja.
Maaj wakuw, Jamis ata waad, “Gwalugwa duw, gwur maaj awuk!
“Sayman kita wanaad atata God bas nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw takwak yakuw, daya nyidim bapa duw nak kwurdidiy di diki.
“God dikidiy maaj wasapwiydiy duw day maaj nak. Ki maaj God diki lapa nyigaam rina.

content.text: Davit dikidiy gwalugwa duw taay vakirkidiy jaba wiy kitik.
Aw day viyakit tikidiy tayir tidaal pik.
Atawa kwurkuw, nuwukadiy duw taakw wun, dayadi Yitaypika Duwaam, sitakira-kidanadiwun.
Nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw ab wun tasakwu-tuwadiy wunadiy-adiy.
Tayir Yitaypika Duw ki maaj wadil. Aw kita di di wada.’”

content: Jamis nuwuka maaj wadidiy, “Wuna mawul atawa wana: Adiy nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy duw taakw mawul warapiykuw, Godak wukijibir tikuw, nyan dayak yawiy samasam kwiybaba.

“Aw kidiy jaav lapa nyigaam sukwunaak dayak: ‘Gwur suwala god ak kwiydadiy kwiy kitikwa. Aw gwur duw taakw kipa yabim vaal yiyi yaan kwurtikwa. Aw adiy animal day kwaliyapaam kaybwukwadaak, kitikwa. Aw nyikiy ab kitikwa.
“Day Mawsis diki lo nabiy samasam ababa Sapat gaba maja wiyaam wadaal. Ababa tipaam day diki maaj wasapwiydaal. Alik day adiy jaav lakwu-kwanadiy.”
Day ki maaj sukwudaal nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duw takwak.

Adiy God dikidiy wayakididiy duwawa, sapakwa nyanugwawa, ababa Kristen yaakiya wadiy day nuwukadiy duw tasakwukuw, day wayaki-kidanadiy Polawa Banapas-awa Antiyakaar. Duw vitiy tasakwudabir, Juwtas Basapas-awa Saylas. Bir daya nyidim tibir sapakwa nyidiy.

Day lapa nyig kwiydaal birakiwa. Ki lapa nyig waal: “Ababa nuwukadiy jaka tipa kidiy gwalugwa duw, gwur Antiyakawa Siriyawa, Silisiyaam kwanadiygwur wakuw, nyan Jiruwsalimaam kwanadiy Jisas dikidiy wayakinadiy duwawa, sapakwa nyanugwawa nyan gwuradiy gwalugwa duw wayapiy sinadiyan gwurak.
“Nyan wukibana nuwukadiy duw, nyana nyidim tikuw, gwurak yikuw, nuwukadiy maaj wadaak gwurak, gwur pitaan warkuw, gwuradiy mawul jawjaay tinadiy. Nyan dayak atawa maa wu.
“Atawa tikuw, nyan vagaluwkuw, yaakiya wanadiyan maaj wayakibanabir duw tasakwukuw, yibirkikik gwurak. Bir nyanabir kapa duw Banapasawa Pol yikinabir.
“Nuwukadiy duw birim viyasipak, bir maa yaag. Bir yin yaan tibagwubir nyanadi Yitaypika Duw Jisas Krais diki yawiy kwurik.
“Kibir wayakibanabir duw, Juwtasawa Saylas, bir gwurak wakibira kidiy lapa nyigaam sukwubanadiy maaj.
“Aw God dikidi Mawul nyanawa yaakiya wadik, nyan gwurak nimadiy yawiy kwatay maa. Gwur kidiy majadika awuk.

“Adiy suwala god ak kwiydadiy kwiy ata kwurin kiwayik. Gwur nyikiy kitikwa. Adiy animal day kwaliyapaam kaybwukidaak, kitikwa. Gwur kipa yabim vaal yiyi yiya-wayik. Kidiy jaav kwar maarkigwura, yara kwakinadiygwur. Gwur yara adakw.”
Nuwukadiy tipa kidiy duw ki maaj wukikuw, rakarak tidiy.
Day adiy duw wayakikuw, Antiyakaar yidiy. Yikuw, a tipa kidiy Kristenak gaam sidiy vagaruwdakik. Day vagaluwkuw, lapa nyig dayak kwiydaal.
Adiy duw taakw lapa nyigaam ril viyakita maaj wukikuw, rakarak samasam tidiy.
Juwtasawa Saylas, God diki maaj wasapwiybir duw tibir. Aw bir maaj samasam dayak wasapwiy-biridiy ap dayak kwiyik dayadiy mawul yara tidakikik.

Bir nyi samasam dayawa tikuw, day birakik wayakidaak, yibir. Day, “Yara maay,” wakuw Jiruwsalimaam kwadiy Kristenak, yibir. Aw Polawa Banapas nuwukadiy nyi Antiyakaam kwabiridiy. Nuwukadiy duwawa bir God dikidiy maaj kalivaan wasapwiyin kwiybiridiy dayak.
Polawa Banapas mawul vitiy tikuw, bir gwutakabir.
Ginyir nuwukadiy nyi yidaak, Pol Banapasak wadid, “An yin vitik adiy gwalugwa duw taakw ababa tipaam tayir an yikuw, God diki maaj wasapwiy-tidiy tipak. Day yara kwanadiy? Ay maa?”
Banapas diki mawul Jon Mak birakiwa yidikikik. Aw Pol maa waad. Di waad tayir Mak birakiwa yikuw, di yirib maa yi. Yikuw nyidib Pabiliyaam, alim wapadibir.
Bir awarwa maaj warjuwkuw, ata gwutakabir. Banapas Mak kwurkuw, ata Saypirisaar yibir jabirasaay.
Aw Pol Saylas tasakwukuw, a tipa kidiy gwalugwa duw taakw God diki tabaam takadabir. Takadaak, bir ata dayaam wapabir.
Bir Siriyawa Silisiya abir tamiyaam yibagwubir ap kwiyik abir tamiyaam kwadiy Kristenak.
